tables.name: tp
tables.columns: k UInt64, u0 UInt64, u1 UInt64, u2 UInt64, u3 UInt64

inserts.insert: INSERT INTO {table} SELECT number * 2 AS k, sipHash64(k, {seed}, {i}) AS u0, u0 % 1000 AS u1, k * 7 AS u2, intDiv(k, 3) AS u3 FROM numbers({rows})
INSERT INTO {table} SELECT number * 2 + 1 AS k, sipHash64(k, {seed}) AS u0, u0 % 1000 AS u1, k * 7 AS u2, intDiv(k, 3) AS u3 FROM numbers({rows})

description: Hold-out: three inserts into partition 0 and one into partition 1 (Compact parts), then DROP PARTITION 0: one empty part covers three. Same parameters as the s3 case; on s3_plain_rewritable.
